name: Aksharantar (AI4Bharat), Odia
licence_source: https://huggingface.co/datasets/ai4bharat/Aksharantar/raw/main/README.md (Licensing Information, read 2026-11-12): "Manually collected data: Released under CC-BY license. Mined dataset (from Samanantar and IndicCorp): Released under CC0 license. Existing sources: Released under CC0 license." Same terms as the Malayalam file (aksharantar.json); the same source filter is applied.
attribution: Aksharantar by AI4Bharat (Madhani et al., 2022), CC BY and CC0. Includes names from Wikidata (CC0).
verdict_reason: The Odia files have no 'Dakshina Dataset' rows (Dakshina has no Odia) and no 'Existing sources' rows, so the filter in training/mlkb/data/human.py drops nothing by source. What is used is mined (IndicCorp, Samanantar: CC0), Wikidata (CC0) or AI4Bharat's manual collection (AK-Uni, AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF: CC BY).
used_for: ori_train.json rows (IndicCorp with mining score >= -0.2, Samanantar, Wikidata) as transliterator training pairs for packs/or.neopack. The manual rows of ori_valid.json (AK-Uni, AK-Freq: 1,096 pairs) fit the romanised Odia tables (data/langs/or/romanisation.json) and validate training. ori_test.json's manual rows (AK-Freq, AK-NEI, AK-NEF, CC BY) are the held-out eval set: its words are left out of every training pair.
notes: Fetched 2026-11-12. Extract with: unzip ori.zip -d data/raw/aksharantar-ori/extracted (data/build-or-text.sh does). ori_train.json has 346,492 rows: IndicCorp 336,766, Samanantar 9,544, Wikidata 182 (no manual rows). ori_valid.json 3,093: IndicCorp 1,893, AK-Uni 571, AK-Freq 525, Samanantar 102, Wikidata 2. ori_test.json 4,228: AK-Freq 2,222, AK-NEI 1,184, AK-NEF 822. The CC0 statement says 'We do not own any of the text from which this data has been extracted': mined pairs are single words, which we treat as unprotectable on their own.
status: in packs/or.neopack (credited in its manifest), not listed on the download site yet, not in the app
